correctness.rationale: For every ring length n>=3 the pair-transfer de Bruijn matrix counts exactly all input-pair collisions. Exact polynomial expansion of its characteristic polynomial and an independently established gap-product/renewal formula agree. Aperiodic positive renewal singularity gives a unique dominant pole and unit leading constant, and the all-zero fibre has strictly smaller exponential growth; independent enumeration and symbolic checks passed.

value.rationale: Exact collision probability measures one-step deterministic information coalescence under a uniform input distribution, a meaningful invariant not supplied by fixed-point or preimage-existence counts. Its all-ring rational second moment and algebraic limiting Rényi-two rate are natural complete statistics for a canonical elementary rule, with a nontrivial dominance comparison between the zero basin and the aggregate of other basins.
